content: Sekiro Champion runs require all **13 bosses** that drop **Memories** to be defeated (excluding Isshin Ashina and “Inner” bosses), with screenshots/videos showing **Base Vitality/Posture**, **Demon Bell** status, and boss drops/empty arenas.
Attack Power is not restricted for this tier.
Sekiro Legend runs require a Champion run plus **two** additional restrictions from the list below.
**Demon Bell** must be active, and **Kuro's Charm** must be given away at the start (No Kuro's Charm).
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **Attack Power** and unlocked Skills.

challenges.title: Deathless All Bosses
items: Genichiro's first encounter must be defeated

content: Sekiro Master runs require a Champion run plus **two Legend restrictions** and **one Master restriction**.
**Demon Bell** must be active, and **No Kuro's Charm** is required.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **Attack Power** and unlocked Skills.

challenges.title: Sword Only Deathless All Bosses
items: Sword Only means no Combat Arts, Items, Buffs, Prosthetic Tools, or Ninjutsu.

content: Sekiro Elite Master runs is a step up in the challenge provided by Master, the required bosses remains the same.
**Demon Bell** and **No Kuro's Charm** are required. For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss.

challenges.title: NG+7 Attack Power 1 Sword Only No Skills

content: Sekiro Grand Master runs is the highest recognised challenge in Onebros. **Demon Bell** and **No Kuro's Charm** are required.
Requires all bosses and minibosses (**All 51 bosses**; Inner and Shura bosses are not included).
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss.

challenges.title: NG+7 Attack Power 1
items: Healing specifically for the Ceremonial Tanto is allowed

restrictions.title: Legend And Above Banned Equipment and Strategies

groups.title: Banned
items: **Shura Ending** is banned (except for NoHit Any%). Emma and Isshin Ashina are not required.
**Reflections/Gauntlets** are banned as alternatives to normal fights due to boss scaling issues. “Inner” bosses are not required.
**Malcontent Whistle, Firecrackers, Fistful of Ash**, and **Snap Seeds** (specifically vs. Corrupted Monk) are banned.
**Mortal Draw** and **Empowered Mortal Draw** are banned.
**Lightning Reversal** is banned (except for the Divine Dragon fight).
**Falling off the boss arena** is banned. This can be used to avoid damage and “respawn” (mainly relevant to DoH but also applies to Gyoubu, SSI, True Monk, and FSM).

content: For No Hit runs, we use **Team Hitless’ ruleset**.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes **Shura Ending No Hit**.
This is a role that will be awarded to anyone who completes **All Memories** or a restricted Any% such as **Shura Ending No Prosthetic** or **Shura Ending Attack Power 1**.
